backup.description: Export the vault to an encrypted file (for example to keep it on another drive) or import data from such a file.

export_dialog.title: Export Vault
export_dialog.description: Saves an encrypted copy of the whole vault to a file of your choice. The file is read back and checked after writing.

import_dialog.title: Import Vault
import_dialog.description: Import service types, services and accounts from a file created with Export.

warnings.replace: All service types, services and accounts in this vault are replaced by the ones from the file. Your current settings and master password are kept. A backup of the current vault is taken first, so you can restore it under Automatic backups.
warnings.merge: Adds the service types, services and accounts that are not in this vault yet. Items that already exist here (same ID) are kept unchanged and skipped; an existing service type only gains fields that it is missing. Your settings and master password do not change.

import_dialog.password_hint: Use the export password chosen when the file was created. Files exported by older AccMan versions open with the master password that was in use at the time of the export.

clipboard.label: Clear clipboard after
clipboard.description: Passwords, keys and 2FA codes you copy are cleared from the clipboard after this time if it still holds them. When the vault locks or AccMan closes, anything AccMan copied is cleared too if it is still on the clipboard. “Never” turns off only the timed clearing.
clipboard.history_note: Clipboard history and cloud clipboard (for example Win+V on Windows) may keep their own copy, which AccMan cannot remove. Turn them off if you copy secrets.

backups.title: Automatic backups
backups.description: AccMan keeps encrypted backup copies of your vault file in a backups folder next to it. A backup is taken:
backups.when_session: before the first change after each unlock;
backups.when_password: before the master password is changed;
backups.when_import: before an import or a restore from a backup;
backups.when_upgrade: before the vault file is upgraded to a newer format.
backups.retention_one: The newest {{count}} backup is kept; older ones are deleted automatically.
backups.retention_other: The newest {{count}} backups are kept; older ones are deleted automatically.
backups.empty: No backups yet. One is taken at each moment listed above. Changes made right after creating the vault, before it is locked for the first time, do not trigger one.
backups.restore_warning: Restoring replaces the current vault with the backup. Each backup opens with the master password that was valid when it was taken, and that password becomes your master password after restoring. The current vault is backed up first.
backups.export_note: Automatic backups are stored on the same disk as the vault. Use Export to keep a copy somewhere else.
